notes:
Did: components/preparation/source-viewer.tsx, a right-hand drawer styled like the transcript drawer. Props: target: SourceTarget | null ({versionId, locator?: {start, end}}) and onClose. It loads documents_get_version and renders passages in order, with Markdown heading_path changes as h3/h4 headings. Every passage whose locator overlaps the target range is marked, and the first is scrolled to the center. An older version reads 'Version N of M'. A deleted document shows 'This source was deleted' and no passages. A load failure shows 'Couldn't open this source.' with Try again. Escape is a capture-phase document listener (preventDefault + stopImmediatePropagation, instant close). It does nothing while a dialog or menu is open. Focus returns to the opener on close. A new target object always re-reads the version, so a reopen after a delete shows the deleted state. Source titles in the sources panel are now buttons that open the latest version (SourcesPanel takes onOpenSource). PreparationPage owns the viewer state and accepts initialSource. The route also reads a deep link /preparation?id=..&source=<versionId>&start=&end= (start >= 0 and start < end, else no locator); the gallery screens use it. src/app/preparation/page.tsx was outside the item's touches.
Learned: a test that stubs document with an EventTarget must unmount its renderer in afterEach, or listeners from earlier tests stay registered and swallow the event. HTMLElement is undefined under bun, so code that runs in effect cleanups must not use instanceof HTMLElement. peek-inline-transcript failed once more in the full gate under load (dark this time), then passed alone and on the next full run.
Assumptions: citations (B2/U5) will pass a SourceTarget into SourceViewer's target prop through state, with the passage locator's start/end. The deep link is read once on mount. Highlighting by overlap rather than exact match means a locator spanning two passages marks both.
